name: United States Military Academy at West Point

facts.value: 12.5% (1,534 admitted of 12,316 applicants; Fall 2024 entry, CDS 2024-25; no 2025-26 CDS posted)
1210-1420 (68% submitted SAT; Fall 2024, CDS 2024-25)
27-33 (32% submitted ACT; Fall 2024, CDS 2024-25)
Average HS GPA 4.1; 43% top 10%, 67% top quarter of HS class (Fall 2024, CDS 2024-25)
SAT, ACT or CLT required, superscored; official scores due by Jan 31 of senior year
No ED or EA; single application for the Class of 2031 open until Jan 31, 2027
CDS 2024-25 C7 rates Interview 'Very Important', but the current steps-to-admission page lists no interview among candidate checklist items; confirm with your regional admissions officer
Important (CDS 2024-25 C7 'Level of applicant's interest'); nomination also required
No major at entry; cadets select a major in the spring of plebe year; a few majors cap enrollment (caps vary by year)
Eligibility: U.S. citizen, age 17-22 on July 1 of entry year, unmarried, no legal obligation to support children; needs trigonometry/pre-calculus and physics or chemistry

Nomination required (both Senators, your Representative, the Vice President, or service-connected sources); each may nominate up to 15 per vacancy; most nomination deadlines fall September-October of senior year
Medical: DoDMERB exam (no cost), scheduled after you become an official candidate
Candidate Fitness Assessment required: basketball throw, pull-ups (or flexed-arm hang), shuttle run, modified sit-ups, push-ups, one-mile run; can be retaken
Service obligation: at least 5 years active duty as an Army officer plus 3 years reserve/IRR
Timeline: application opens Feb 15 of junior year; apply for nominations and take the CFA in fall of senior year; candidate checklist (incl. essays) due Jan 31; Class of 2031 enters July 2027
Gap: essays are part of the candidate checklist but the prompts are only in the candidate portal and were not reviewed
